hypothesis: Use a corpus-trained, task-agnostic SELFIES VAE only as a de novo generator, then tilt its latent prior with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling using online probability of improvement from an exact Tanimoto Gaussian process over count-based molecular fingerprints, and greedily select each protocol-sized batch by expected improvement.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic SELFIES variational autoencoder on the unlabeled corpus solely as a de novo molecular generator, while fitting the online objective surrogate only on oracle-evaluated molecules using count-based molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto Gaussian process. At each feedback round, use preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling to draw new latent points from the VAE prior tilted by the GP posterior probability of exceeding the incumbent, decode them into previously unseen molecules, and greedily choose a high-utility batch of ten. Decoupling generation from structure-space prediction avoids requiring objective smoothness in the VAE latent geometry and directs the fixed 290 post-initial oracle calls toward molecules likely to improve the final Top-1 rather than screening or retrieving a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline unlabeled VAE training plus an online exact Tanimoto Gaussian process fit only to evaluated molecules
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling from a structure-GP-conditioned VAE prior followed by greedy batch utility selection
method_tags.representation: SELFIES VAE latent generator with count-based molecular fingerprints for structure-space prediction

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, log the mean GP posterior probability of improvement for unique valid pCN-retained decodes minus that for matched unique valid decodes from the untilted VAE prior, then aggregate the paired lift over rounds.
activation_observables.name: posterior_tilt_probability_of_improvement_lift

activation_observables.measurement: Log attempted and accepted pCN transitions whose Metropolis log ratio has a nonzero GP probability-of-improvement contribution, reporting their count and acceptance fraction per suggestion round.
activation_observables.name: pcn_posterior_transition_activity

activation_observables.measurement: For each round, compare mean GP expected improvement of the greedily selected unique batch with mean expected improvement of the full unique valid posterior-tilted decode pool from which it was selected.
activation_observables.name: greedy_batch_expected_improvement_lift

activation_observables.measurement: Measure per round the fraction of posterior-tilted VAE decodes that canonicalize as valid molecules and are absent from both the evaluated set and earlier candidates in the current generation pool.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_decode_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus is sufficient for the SELFIES VAE to decode a usable rate of valid, novel molecules without using corpus members as a finite proposal pool.
The task objective has enough local regularity under count-based molecular fingerprint similarity for a sparse-data Tanimoto GP to rank useful regions.
The 300-call budget supplies enough feedback rounds to refit the online surrogate and alter the posterior-tilted proposal distribution.
The result may not transfer when decisive objective structure is systematically aliased by the chosen count fingerprint or lies outside the generator's learned support.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if, after the initial fit and subsequent feedback, no selected unique valid molecule can be traced to a pCN transition with a nonzero GP posterior tilt, or selected batches show no positive predicted-utility lift over their untilted prior references.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to train and publish the unlabeled-corpus SELFIES VAE, and implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, fit and refit the fingerprint Tanimoto GP only on oracle-evaluated molecules, sample novel latent states with a GP-posterior probability-of-improvement pCN target, decode them de novo, and choose the announced batch size through greedy expected-improvement utility while excluding invalid and previously proposed molecules.
research_intent.mechanism: Use a corpus-trained, task-agnostic SELFIES VAE only as a de novo generator, then tilt its latent prior with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling using online probability of improvement from an exact Tanimoto Gaussian process over count-based molecular fingerprints, and greedily select each protocol-sized batch by expected improvement.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo optimizer must turn extremely sparse feedback into useful proposals without assuming that objective values are smooth in the generator's latent coordinates or screening a finite corpus pool.

applicability_conditions: Supported on this unlabeled corpus and decoder configuration: prepare encoded 99,822 training examples, and all 145 rounds produced at least 240 unique valid posterior-pool molecules with aggregate novel-valid decode yield 0.9081992337164757.

Supported when the count-based Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto GP provides usable ranking signal: the posterior-versus-prior mean PI lift was positive in aggregate for every evaluated task, and greedy batch EI lift was positive in all 145 rounds.

Supported under the 300-call, batch-10 protocol: each task completed 29 adaptive feedback rounds, GP training observations advanced from 10 to 290, and all 300 oracle calls were consumed without invalid or duplicate proposals.

The posterior-tilt effect was task-dependent. Zaleplon_mpo had positive per-round PI lift in only 3/29 rounds and only a 1.1947511043448278e-07 positive mean lift, so transfer is least supported when predicted improvement collapses near the numerical probability floor.

The evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and does not establish transfer when decisive objective structure is aliased by the radius-2 count fingerprint or lies outside the trained VAE's decoded support.

Lines 361-429 implement the count-fingerprint Tanimoto GP and PI/EI; lines 443-481 load the VAE artifact and seed all session RNG state; lines 496-510 admit only evaluator observations to the GP training state; lines 544-688 refit the GP, execute pCN transitions, gate pool entries on accepted nonzero PI log-ratio activity, draw the untilted prior control, and compute transition/yield observables; lines 690-741 greedily select by EI and emit the activation record; and lines 781-819 feed accepted oracle results into the next round. Each of seed-0/logs/{zaleplon_mpo,deco_hop,drd2_docking,median_2,sitagliptin_mpo}.log contains 29 activation_observables records with observations advancing from 10 to 290 and exposes every registered metric. The seed-0 summary.json reports status ok, all 300 oracle calls per task, and zero invalid or duplicate attempts.
